about: The guardian (dream visitor) being created, on the server and replicated: Race, Subrace, BodyType, BodyShape, RootTemplate, Voice, Visual. The guardian character of the prologue takes its CharacterCreationAppearance from it.

evidence.says: Script Extender exposes it as CCCompanionDefinition

its Visual written on the server (11 Visuals, a skin colour) before FinishCreating; in TUT_Avernus_C the character of template Elves_Female_Wood_Daisy carried those 11 Visuals and that skin colour in CharacterCreationAppearance
Script Extender's header Components/CharacterCreation.h binds CCCompanionDefinition to this engine name; the offsets are the ones its legacy field names carry, Visual placed after RootTemplate
reported from a run of character creation, not read again here: a server write of Visual and Voice followed by Replicate is carried by the guardian into the prologue
